name: MyChannels
overview: Fork of JPKribs Live Channels with an expanded scheduling model and filler support.
description: MyChannels is a fork of JPKribs' Live Channels plugin, extended with per-entry weight and block size, weighted round-robin scheduling, filler pools for bumpers and trailers, an auto-generated Up Next card, and event-driven cache invalidation. Channels, their guide, and their streams are served in-process through Jellyfin's own Live TV.

versions.changelog:
Initial fork release.

Forked from JPKribs/jellyfin-plugin-livechannels v10.11.12.1 with:

- **JS import subpath fix** — the plugin's config-page dynamic imports were
  using an absolute  path that broke on subpath
  deployments (). Changed to 
  to resolve relative to the config page URL.

Feature work per DESIGN.md follows in subsequent releases:

- Per-entry weight + block size with layered defaults
- Weighted round-robin scheduling (algorithm ported from ErsatzTV)
- Filler pools for bumpers/trailers + auto-generated Up Next card
- Improved save-flow UX (button state, fewer round-trips)
- Library-event cache invalidation
